text: Reputation has lost much of its meaning during the current institutional disruption: people in dying fields cash in on reputations built over previous generations in a fire sale mentality, and reputation itself is becoming a suspect concept.
citation: Craig Calcaterra, Wulf A. Kaal, The Importance of Reputation for the Evolution of Decentralization (2021). SSRN: https://ssrn.com/abstract=3782210

isBasedOn.name: The Importance of Reputation for the Evolution of Decentralization

abstract: Reputation has lost much of its meaning during the disruption that we are expe- riencing as the global society is emerging. As old institutions fall, there is a fire sale mentality amongst people in dying fields where they cash in on the reputations that were built over previous generations.

additionalProperty.name: scope_conditions
value: the current period of institutional decline and global society emergence
